msaada.title: Help & Support
msaada.subtitle: We're here to help. Check our frequently asked questions or contact us directly.

faqs.question: How do I sign up for Nusrah?
faqs.answer: Click 'Join Now', fill in your basic information, then verify your account using the code (OTP) sent to your email.

faqs.question: What's the difference between the plans?
faqs.answer: Each plan (Free, Basic, Silver, Gold, Premium) offers a different level of profile visibility, communication, and extra features like voice and video calls. See the 'Membership' page for full details.

faqs.question: Is my information safe?
faqs.answer: Yes. Your password is stored encrypted, and sensitive information like your phone number is stored encrypted and only shown with your permission.

faqs.question: Can I cancel or change my plan at any time?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time from the Account page.

faqs.question: What should I do if I have a complaint about another member?
faqs.answer: Use the 'Send Message' form below or contact us by phone/WhatsApp. Our team will handle your complaint quickly and confidentially.

faqs.question: How are payments made?
faqs.answer: Paid plans are paid for via mobile money (M-Pesa and others). After paying, your account is activated automatically once the system confirms payment.
